page.layout: Three columns of index entries, one page of the Index, with the running title "INDEX" and the Roman numeral X. above the first column. Column 1 runs from "Ecclesiastici" to "Euftachius"; column 2 from "perstitionum" to "Finis omnium"; column 3 from "Finis omnium" to "Gratia Dei". Section letters F. and G. appear in columns 2 and 3. No marginal text. Catchword "Gratiæ" at the lower right.

page.notes: Printed running title reads "INDEX X." at the head; the X. is taken as the page number. Doubtful: "faciēda" (Filio quoque entry), "Gentiū" (macron uncertain), "speɔtanda" (scan shows a rounded form, read as spectanda; the printed letter is unclear), "refuscirati" and "Gloriatio & merces Pauli 128 / 130.b" (numbers split across lines as printed). Section letters F. and G. are printed as bare letters and set as list lines. Entries wrapped across lines are kept on separate lines as printed.
